title: Buddhism for Beginners

title: The Eight Sufferings of the Buddha
description: A Buddhist psychology book about recurring emotional pain, attachment, anxiety, loss, rejection and the roots of human suffering.

description: A psychological journey through the life of Siddhartha Gautama, connecting the Buddha's life story with suffering, attachment, awakening and modern psychology.

title: How to Find Your Soul Mission

title: Tarot Is Not Fortune-Telling
description: A psychological approach to tarot that uses the 78 cards as mirrors for self-reflection, thought patterns and inner awareness rather than fortune-telling.

title: The Psychology of the I Ching
description: A modern psychological reading of the I Ching with 64 ancient lessons for uncertainty, decision-making and rebuilding inner stability.

title: Dark Psychology

title: The Ransom on the Road to Freedom
description: A philosophical exploration of freedom, sacrifice and the personal price required to reclaim autonomy and live with greater inner freedom.
